units.locator: Article 20.29. Production and dissemination of extremist materials
units.text: Mass dissemination of extremist materials included in the published federal list of extremist materials or other extremist materials specified in point 3 of Article 1 of Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 114-ФЗ ‘On Combating Extremist Activities’, or their production or storage for mass dissemination, except in the cases provided for by parts 4.1 and 6 of Article 13.15 and Articles 13.37, 20.3 and 20.3.2 of this Code, if these acts do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days, with confiscation of those materials and the equipment used to produce them; for officials, two thousand to five thousand roubles with confiscation of those materials and the equipment used to produce them; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to one million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days, with confiscation of those materials and the equipment used to produce them.
